name: webweaver-mcp-server
description: MCP server for WebWeaver Nexus — contact form, product overview, and contact info

scripts.build: cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run watch" "npm run serve"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build && npm run serve
